text:
jordan: CI red on PR #6123 — `build/publish-image` failed during push with 'upload cancelled' from registry, happened on canary tag. anyone seen interleaved upload cancels when GC/prune runs?

ci-bot: job build/publish-image (PR 6123) • failed • see logs: https://ci.example.com/builds/6123/logs

jordan: paste of error from runner logs: ```
PUT /v2/redwood/canary/blobs/uploads/xyz?digest=sha256:abc
HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted
...
PATCH /v2/.../uploads/xyz -> 499 Client Closed Request / upload cancelled by peer
error: write failed: connection reset by peer
```

sam: I saw a similar pattern last month where our registry GC overlapped with parallel pushes. It returned 409/gone though, not 499. Did the runner retry?

jordan: CI didn't retry automatically — pipeline stops on non-200 from push step. I kicked off a rerun and it passed. but want to avoid flaps.

natalie: did anything change in the Dockerfile or build context? dockerignore edits can change chunk boundaries which made uploads align differently and hit a race before.

jordan: small Dockerfile reorder in the PR (moved a COPY up). Also added `.dockerignore` tweak to exclude `/dist/tmp`.

ops-mike: registry logs show a concurrent GC around that minute, and an abort for upload xyz from IP 10.4.5.22. Looks like the upload got tombstoned during commit window. registry-bot can share exact GC window.

registry-bot: GC job started at 2026-03-17T10:14:02Z, compaction step at 10:14:28Z, completed 10:14:45Z. Aborted uploads reconciled at 10:14:31Z.

sam: ok that's the smoking gun. Two mitigations: enable CI push retry with backoff, and add a short guard in registry to defer GC if active uploads > N.

jordan: agree — I'll open a tiny CI change to add 2 retries for push (exponential backoff). putting a ticket for registry GC coordination: ENGINFRA-982.

natalie: also add a note to the PR checklist: avoid large dockerignore churn in canary pushes, and if you must change dockerignore, run a local push to our dev registry first.

jordan: thanks. rerun passed so I'm unblocking PR but will land with the CI retry change in a follow-up. :thumbsup:

ops-mike: will follow up on registry side — can add a short lock to prevent GC during mass push windows. :eyes:
